Understand & Map Your Software

Interactive visual flowcharts, execution sequence diagrams, and AI-powered gap analysis for agent skills and full-stack codebases.

AI Agent Skills & Playbooks

Skill Flow Mapper

Visualize and refine Claude skills, markdown playbooks, and agent workflows as interactive diagrams. Find unhandled branches and logic gaps, and auto-fix files with AI.

  • ✓Interactive workflow diagrams with decision branches & loops
  • ✓Automated gap detection for missing error paths & unhandled states
  • ✓In-browser AI chat that applies diffs directly into your markdown
  • ✓Mermaid flowchart export & line-level reviewer notes
Or try demo: ·
Full Codebases & Repositories

Project Flow Mapper

Open an entire software codebase or .zip archive to understand its architecture and runtime paths. Traces HTTP routes, startup scripts, and sequence diagrams with animated data flow.

  • ✓Traces routes & calls in JS/TS, Python, Go, Java, and more
  • ✓Animated data flow runner with live moving dots (Space to play)
  • ✓Component architecture dependency graphs & file tree inspector
  • ✓'Read with Me' voice companion & high-res image export
Or try demo: ·
